meta.title: John Smith Football Coaching — St. Johns County, FL
meta.description: Youth and high school quarterback training in St. Augustine, FL. Personalized coaching from Coach John Smith — 9 years developing athletes in St. Johns County.

about.name: Coach John Smith
about.bio: Coach John Smith has been developing quarterbacks and building confident athletes in St. Johns County for nearly a decade. His passion for the game and his players shows in every session.

hero.headline: St. Johns County's Premier QB Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.
